title: Chintamani Library v2.7.9 — Immediate Auto-Update Engine, Splash Restored, 72/65 Seats & Clean Data
releaseNotes: REAL-TIME UPDATE ENGINE: Switched update manifest discovery to high-speed raw GitHub CDN (100ms response), eliminating delays and stale CDN caching
SPLASH SCREEN RESTORED: Returned to exact original loading screen with golden aura painter, 110px insignia, dual branch badge, and smooth progress tracking
SINGLE HALL SEAT ALLOCATION: Strictly enforced 72 seats (K01–K72) for Khalilabad and 65 seats (M01–M65) for Mehdawal in a Single Study Hall; removed all non-standard and random seat numbering
DEMO DATA PURGED: Completely removed synthetic demo members; app now serves only genuine scholar records
MEMBER CARD SEAT DISPLAY: Fixed unassigned seat indicator to cleanly display '—' instead of random numbers derived from member codes
AUTOMATIC IN-APP POLLING: Added 60s background update check so new releases are announced immediately even while app is open
